note: Reviewed features: feature -> expected behaviour -> test coverage. Definitions only; status, evidence and deployed inclusion are DERIVED (derive_features.py, verify_release.py). A customer-facing change that is not a verified fix for a gap is allowed through THIS route when its feature has an approved review by a named reviewer with a reference, a stated expected behaviour, and test coverage (required rows in the assertion catalog, or new rows for a catalog version that exists). No feature is invented: the list is empty until the owner and reviewer add entries (see templates/feature-entry.template.json).

expectedBehaviour.summary: An explicitly enabled private test session can bind the owned terminal Focus status chain to its session without retaining transcript or objective text.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: For AHT-02 and AHT-03, the enabled diagnostic exposes only ordered hashes and status counts from the owned successful Focus publication; normal sessions expose nothing, invalid or capacity-exhausted work publishes nothing, and the witness never delays save or finalization.

features.title: Bind recording setup failures to the accepted attempt

review.reviewedBy: Combined Codex Code and Security reviews

expectedBehaviour.summary: A recording setup failure is diagnosed against the accepted journey and attempt rather than ambient later state.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: Source controls bind an emitted setup diagnostic to the accepted attempt and refuse invalid or pre-acceptance identities. AHT-12 owner/press rows cover the normal journey boundary only; they do not independently prove server telemetry delivery.

coverage.diagnosticLimit: Accepted-attempt telemetry delivery is not independently observed by these rows.

features.title: Update an existing owner's goal instead of inserting a duplicate

review.reviewedBy: Combined Codex Code and Security reviews

expectedBehaviour.summary: Saving an edited goal updates the existing owner-scoped row without creating a second current goal.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: A second save for the same authenticated owner's existing goal performs the owner-scoped update, preserves permission failures, and leaves one current goal for the next Focus session.

coverage.diagnosticLimit: The selected all-15 campaign proves the owner-bound Focus journey remains healthy; the two-save same-row goal update is source-tested but is not independently exercised by this approved live campaign.

features.title: Retain content-free PCM boundary receipts for transcription diagnosis

review.reviewedBy: Combined Codex Code and Security reviews

expectedBehaviour.summary: The private transcription path retains bounded PCM frame-boundary evidence without retaining speech content.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: Reviewed source controls order content-free PCM boundary receipts and refuse post-closure overwrite. The AHT-02/03 Focus and no-cloud-STT rows cover normal transcription regression only; missing PCM diagnostics remain unverified rather than inheriting those PASS results.

coverage.diagnosticLimit: PCM diagnostic receipt presence and integrity are not independently observed by these rows.

features.title: Preserve Gemini coaching behind a replaceable provider adapter

review.reviewedBy: Combined Codex Code and Security reviews

expectedBehaviour.summary: The coaching function resolves the incumbent Gemini implementation through a typed provider registry without changing the selected default.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: With the existing configuration, saved Open Mic and Focus takes still request Gemini coaching through the registered adapter and return the same grounded two-part coaching contract; unselected model families are not activated.
